summary: A mixed day driven by retail sector developments and competitor legal challenges. PepsiCo and Monster are challenging India's energy drink labeling ban, while Coffee Island targets aggressive expansion; separately, India's consumer durables market is projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030.

bullets.text: PepsiCo and Monster Beverage initiated legal action against India's food regulator over recent energy drink labeling ban.
Greek specialty coffee chain Coffee Island India targets 70-75 cafés by March 2029, opening 20 by March 2027.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030.
Reliance Industries eyes $1 billion debt fundraise through securitization deal.
Bombay High Court declined to book MP Parth Pawar in Mundhwa Land Scam despite his 99% stake.
